```{python}
# Reads analysis/phase2.py's TSVs from $PHASE2_RESULTS (default ../results/phase2).
# Render: `pixi run report2`, or PHASE2_RESULTS=<dir> quarto render report/phase2.qmd
# Figures are static matplotlib images, one set per Leiden resolution; the resolution slider
# shows one set at a time. The trade-off and threshold views are computed in the page from the
# embedded table. Plain JavaScript, no libraries: one self-contained HTML file that works offline.
import base64
import html
import io
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("../analysis").resolve()))
import figures as fg  # omnicol and the shared figure style

R = Path(os.environ.get("PHASE2_RESULTS", "../results/phase2"))


def tsv(name):
    p = R / f"phase2_{name}.tsv"
    return pd.read_csv(p, sep="\t", dtype={"res_key": str}) if p.exists() else pd.DataFrame()


bounds, runs, stages = tsv("bounds"), tsv("runs"), tsv("stages")
pipes, pipe_runs, stage_conc = tsv("pipelines"), tsv("pipelines_runs"), tsv("stage_concordance")
if not len(stages) or "res_key" not in stages.columns:
    raise RuntimeError(f"no per-resolution phase2_stages.tsv in {R}: run analysis/phase2.py first")

ORACLE = "oracle"
RES_KEYS = [ORACLE] + sorted((k for k in stages["res_key"].unique() if k != ORACLE), key=float)
datasets = sorted(stages["dataset"].unique())
PIPE_ORDER = ["baseline", "scanpy-defaults", "tuned-cpu", "all-gpu", "hybrid"]
PIPE_COLOUR = {p: fg.OMNICOL[i] for i, p in enumerate(PIPE_ORDER)}
MOD_COLOUR = {}
for s_ in ("pca", "knn", "cluster"):
    for i, m in enumerate(sorted(stages.loc[stages["stage"] == s_, "module"].unique())):
        MOD_COLOUR[m] = fg.OMNICOL[i % len(fg.OMNICOL)]
MARKERS = ["o", "s", "^", "D", "v", "P", "X", "*"]
STAGE_NAME = {"pca": "PCA", "knn": "kNN", "cluster": "Leiden"}
GPU = lambda k: "rapids" in str(k) or "gpu" in str(k) or k == "hybrid"  # noqa: E731


def raw(s):
    """Raw HTML into the page (an `output: asis` cell's printed text)."""
    print(f"\n```{{=html}}\n{s}\n```\n")


def table(df, digits=3):
    """A DataFrame as a plain HTML table: no notebook widget machinery, no remote scripts."""
    def cell(v):
        if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)):
            return "—" if not np.isfinite(v) else f"{v:.{digits}f}"
        return html.escape(str(v))
    head = "".join(f"<th>{html.escape(str(c))}</th>" for c in df.columns)
    body = "".join("<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{cell(v)}</td>" for v in row) + "</tr>"
                   for row in df.itertuples(index=False))
    raw(f'<div class="tbl"><table><thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead><tbody>{body}</tbody></table></div>')


def show(fig):
    """A figure as an embedded PNG (figures.py selects the Agg backend: nothing to display)."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=100)
    plt.close(fig)
    raw(f'<img src="data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()}" style="max-width:100%">')


def plain_log(axis):
    axis.set_major_locator(mticker.LogLocator(subs=(1.0, 2.0, 5.0)))
    axis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v:g}"))
    axis.set_minor_formatter(mticker.NullFormatter())


def panels(data, y, ylabel, group, colours, logy=False, floors=None, note=None):
    """One panel per dataset: y against cells, one line per group, each with its own marker so
    lines on top of each other stay visible. GPU (rapids) dashed. floors: optional frame with
    dataset, cells, label, value drawn as grey dotted lines."""
    if not len(data) or data[y].dropna().empty:
        print("\n_Nothing to show here._\n")
        return
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(datasets), figsize=(max(5.5, 3.4 * len(datasets)), 3.2), sharey=True,
                             constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    seen = {}
    for ax, d in zip(axes[0], datasets):
        s = data[data["dataset"] == d].sort_values("cells")
        if floors is not None and len(floors):
            for lab, f in floors[floors["dataset"] == d].sort_values("cells").groupby("label"):
                h = ax.plot(f["cells"], f["value"], ls=":", lw=1.2, color="#8c8b87")[0]
                seen.setdefault("own seed noise (grey)", h)
        for i, (key, g) in enumerate(s.groupby(group, sort=True)):
            g = g.dropna(subset=[y])
            if len(g):
                seen[key] = ax.plot(g["cells"], g[y], marker=MARKERS[i % len(MARKERS)], ms=5 - 0.4 * (i % 4),
                                    lw=1.4, ls="--" if GPU(key) else "-", mfc="none" if i % 2 else None,
                                    color=colours.get(key, "#52514e"))[0]
        ax.set_xscale("log")
        ticks = sorted(s["cells"].dropna().unique())
        ax.set_xticks(ticks, [f"{c / 1000:g}k" for c in ticks])
        ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(mticker.NullFormatter())
        if logy:
            ax.set_yscale("log")
            plain_log(ax.yaxis)
        ax.set_title(d, loc="left")
        ax.set_xlabel("cells")
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel(ylabel)
    fig.legend(seen.values(), seen.keys(), loc="outside right center", frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    show(fig)
    if note:
        print(f"\n{note}\n")


def per_res(fn):
    """fn(res_key) once per resolution, each in a pane the resolution slider shows or hides."""
    for k in RES_KEYS:
        print(f'\n::: {{.res-pane data-res="{k}"}}\n')
        fn(k)
        print("\n:::\n")


def res_text(k, own="each at its own oracle resolution"):
    return own if k == ORACLE else f"at resolution {k}"


def st(stage, k=ORACLE):
    t = stages[(stages["stage"] == stage) & (stages["res_key"] == k)]
    return t.rename(columns={"subsample": "size"}).sort_values(["module", "dataset", "cells"])


def cols(t, names):
    return t[[c for c in names if c in t.columns]]


def seedless(stage):
    t = st(stage)
    m = sorted(t.loc[t["stage_stability"].isna(), "module"].unique())
    if m:
        print(f"\n_No seed (exact or deterministic): {', '.join(m)}. Their run-to-run differences are "
              "**reproducibility**: the same job run again in another output folder._\n")


# ---- the four subtabs, one function each, the same for every stage ------------------------

def stability(stage):
    if stage == "cluster":
        def pane(k):
            t = st(stage, k)
            print(f"Agreement (ARI) between runs of one Leiden that differ only in its seed, {res_text(k)}; "
                  "reproducibility: the same seed run again in another folder.\n")
            panels(t, "stage_stability", "stability (ARI between seeds)", "module", MOD_COLOUR,
                   note="_Solid: CPU; dashed: GPU._")
            table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "stage_stability", "stage_reproducibility"]))
        per_res(pane)
        return
    measure = "variance-weighted subspace agreement" if stage == "pca" else "shared neighbours"
    t = st(stage)
    print(f"**On the stage's own measure** ({measure}): agreement between runs of one {STAGE_NAME[stage]} "
          "that differ only in its seed.\n")
    panels(t, "stage_stability", f"stability ({measure})", "module", MOD_COLOUR)
    seedless(stage)
    if t["stage_reproducibility"].notna().any():
        panels(t, "stage_reproducibility", f"reproducibility ({measure})", "module", MOD_COLOUR)
    table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "stage_stability", "stage_reproducibility"]))

    def pane(k):
        t = st(stage, k)
        res = ("the baseline pipeline's oracle resolution" if k == ORACLE else f"resolution {k}")
        print(f"**Downstream**: the ARI of the final clusters (baseline Leiden, seed 0, at {res}) between "
              f"runs that differ only in the {STAGE_NAME[stage]} seed.\n")
        panels(t, "downstream_stability", "downstream stability (ARI)", "module", MOD_COLOUR,
               note="_Solid: CPU; dashed: GPU._")
        table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "downstream_stability",
                       "downstream_reproducibility"]))
    per_res(pane)


def _conc_panels(c, t, ylabel, floor_col):
    c = c.merge(t[["dataset", "size", "cells"]].drop_duplicates(), on=["dataset", "size"])
    c["pair"] = c["A"] + " vs " + c["B"]
    floors = t.dropna(subset=[floor_col]).assign(label=lambda x: x["module"], value=lambda x: x[floor_col])
    panels(c, "between median", ylabel, "pair",
           {p: fg.OMNICOL[i % len(fg.OMNICOL)] for i, p in enumerate(sorted(c["pair"].unique()))}, floors=floors)
    table(cols(c.sort_values(["dataset", "cells", "A", "B"]),
               ["dataset", "size", "A", "B", "within A median", "within B median", "between median", "gap A", "gap B"]), 4)


CONC_NOTE = ("**Gap** = a module's own seed floor − agreement between the two. **Positive**: switching "
             "implementation moves the result further than re-seeding that one does. Against a module "
             "without a seed (one run), only the seeded side's gap is defined.")


def concordance(stage):
    c = stage_conc[stage_conc["stage"] == stage].rename(columns={"subsample": "size"}) if len(stage_conc) else pd.DataFrame()
    if not len(c):
        print("_No pairs._\n")
        return
    if stage == "cluster":
        def pane(k):
            t = st(stage, k)
            ck = c[c["res_key"] == k]
            res = "the baseline Leiden's oracle resolution" if k == ORACLE else f"resolution {k}"
            print(f"Do two Leiden implementations find the same partitions (ARI), beyond what each one's own "
                  f"seed noise (grey) explains? At {res}, on exact PCA and kNN. {CONC_NOTE}\n")
            if len(ck):
                _conc_panels(ck, t, "ARI between implementations", "stage_stability")
        per_res(pane)
        return
    measure = "variance-weighted subspace agreement" if stage == "pca" else "shared neighbours"
    print(f"Agreement between two {STAGE_NAME[stage]} implementations on the stage's own measure "
          f"({measure}), against each one's own seed noise (grey). {CONC_NOTE}\n")
    _conc_panels(c, st(stage), "subspace agreement" if stage == "pca" else "shared neighbours", "stage_stability")


def accuracy(stage):
    if stage == "cluster":
        def pane(k):
            t = st(stage, k)
            print("ARI of the final clusters against the reference labels, as a share of the oracle bound "
                  f"(1: as good as a classifier trained on the labels), {res_text(k)}.\n")
            panels(t, "accuracy_share", "accuracy (share of oracle)", "module", MOD_COLOUR)
            table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "accuracy_ari", "accuracy_share"]))
        per_res(pane)
        sl = runs[runs["varies"].isin(["none", "cluster"]) & runs["pca_seed"].astype(str).isin(["0", "nan"])
                  & runs["knn_seed"].astype(str).isin(["0", "nan"])]
        acc = (sl.groupby(["cluster", "dataset", "subsample", "resolution"])["ari_truth"].median()
               .unstack("resolution").reset_index().rename(columns={"cluster": "module", "subsample": "size"}))
        acc = acc.merge(bounds.rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})[["dataset", "size", "cells"]], on=["dataset", "size"])
        acc = acc.sort_values(["module", "dataset", "cells"]).drop(columns="cells")
        acc.columns = [f"res {c:g}" if isinstance(c, float) else c for c in acc.columns]
        print("**Median ARI at every resolution** (each row's best is its oracle resolution)\n")
        table(acc)
        return
    what = ("share of the exact top-50 variance the method's subspace holds" if stage == "pca"
            else "recall of the exact (brute-force) neighbours")
    print(f"**Fidelity to exact**: {what}.\n")
    t = st(stage)
    panels(t, "fidelity", "fidelity to exact", "module", MOD_COLOUR)

    def pane(k):
        t = st(stage, k)
        res = ("the baseline pipeline's oracle resolution, so another resolution cannot rescue a worse "
               f"{STAGE_NAME[stage]}" if k == ORACLE else f"resolution {k}")
        print("**Downstream accuracy**: ARI of the final clusters (baseline Leiden, seed 0) against the labels, "
              f"as a share of the oracle bound, at {res}.\n")
        panels(t, "accuracy_share", "downstream accuracy (share of oracle)", "module", MOD_COLOUR,
               note="_Solid: CPU; dashed: GPU._")
        table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "fidelity", "accuracy_ari", "accuracy_share"]))
    per_res(pane)


def cost(stage):
    note = ("Start-up and imports included, queue excluded. Cold starts (the first rapids job of a module "
            "in a folder) left out where there are others.")
    if stage == "cluster":
        def pane(k):
            t = st(stage, k)
            print(f"Wall time of one Leiden run, {res_text(k)}. {note}\n")
            panels(t, "cost_s", "wall time (s)", "module", MOD_COLOUR, logy=True, note="_Solid: CPU; dashed: GPU._")
            table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "cost_s"]), 2)
        per_res(pane)
        return
    t = st(stage)
    print(f"Wall time of the {STAGE_NAME[stage]} job. {note}\n")
    panels(t, "cost_s", "wall time (s)", "module", MOD_COLOUR, logy=True, note="_Solid: CPU; dashed: GPU._")
    table(cols(t, ["module", "dataset", "size", "cells", "cost_s"]), 2)


# ---- Full pipeline ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def pipeline_pane(k):
    p = pipes[pipes["res_key"] == k].rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})
    if not len(p):
        print("_No pipeline results at this resolution._\n")
        return
    pr = pipe_runs[pipe_runs["res_key"] == k].rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})
    if k == ORACLE:
        print("Each pipeline at **its own oracle resolution**; cost per answer = PCA + kNN + Leiden at "
              "**every** resolution of the sweep, since choosing the best needs them all.\n")
    else:
        print(f"Every pipeline at **resolution {k}**; cost per answer = PCA + kNN + **one** Leiden run.\n")
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(datasets), figsize=(max(5.5, 3.4 * len(datasets)), 3.2), sharey=True,
                             constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    for ax, d in zip(axes[0], datasets):
        cells_max = p.loc[p["dataset"] == d, "cells"].max()
        sub = pr[(pr["dataset"] == d) & pr["size"].isin(p.loc[(p["dataset"] == d) & (p["cells"] == cells_max), "size"])]
        for name in PIPE_ORDER:
            v = np.sort(sub.loc[sub["named"] == name, "accuracy_share"].dropna().to_numpy())
            if len(v):
                ax.step(np.r_[v[0], v], np.r_[0, np.arange(1, len(v) + 1) / len(v)], where="post",
                        color=PIPE_COLOUR[name], lw=1.6, ls="--" if GPU(name) else "-", label=name)
        for x in (0, 1):
            ax.axvline(x, color="#8c8b87", ls=":", lw=1)
        ax.set_title(f"{d} · {cells_max / 1000:g}k cells", loc="left")
        ax.set_xlabel("accuracy (share of oracle)")
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel("share of runs ≤ x")
    h, l = axes[0][0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    fig.legend(h, l, loc="outside right center", frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    show(fig)
    print("\n_Accuracy over seeds at each dataset's largest size; grey: chance (0) and oracle (1)._\n")
    panels(p, "accuracy_share", "accuracy (share of oracle)", "pipeline", PIPE_COLOUR)
    panels(p, "stability", "stability (ARI between seeds)", "pipeline", PIPE_COLOUR)
    if p["reproducibility"].notna().any():
        panels(p, "reproducibility", "reproducibility (ARI, same seed)", "pipeline", PIPE_COLOUR)
    panels(p, "cost_s", "wall time per answer (s)", "pipeline", PIPE_COLOUR, logy=True,
           note="_Dashed: pipelines with GPU stages._")
    table(cols(p.sort_values(["dataset", "cells", "pipeline"]),
               ["pipeline", "dataset", "size", "cells", "resolution", "runs", "accuracy_ari", "accuracy_share",
                "stability", "reproducibility", "cost_s"]))
    big = p[p["cells"] == p.groupby("dataset")["cells"].transform("max")]
    trio = [("cost_s", "stability", "cost against stability"), ("cost_s", "accuracy_share", "cost against accuracy"),
            ("stability", "accuracy_share", "accuracy against stability")]
    label = {"cost_s": "wall time per answer (s)", "stability": "stability", "accuracy_share": "accuracy (share of oracle)"}
    print("\n**Two measures at a time**, each dataset at its largest size\n")
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(datasets), 3, figsize=(11, 3.1 * len(datasets)), constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    for row, d in zip(axes, datasets):
        sub = big[big["dataset"] == d]
        for ax, (x, y, title) in zip(row, trio):
            for _, r in sub.iterrows():
                ax.scatter(r[x], r[y], s=45, color=PIPE_COLOUR[r["pipeline"]], label=r["pipeline"])
            if x == "cost_s":
                ax.set_xscale("log")
                plain_log(ax.xaxis)
            ax.set_xlabel(label[x])
            ax.set_ylabel(label[y])
            ax.set_title(f"{d} · {sub['cells'].max() / 1000:g}k · {title}", loc="left", fontsize=8)
    h, l = axes[0][0].get_legend_handles_labels()
    fig.legend(h, l, loc="outside right center", frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    show(fig)
```

raw(f"""<style>{css}</style>

<input type="range" id="p2-res-slider" min="0" max="{len(RES_KEYS) - 1}" step="1" value="0">

<script>

  function set(i) {{
    document.body.dataset.res = keys[i];
    document.getElementById("p2-res-label").textContent = labels[i];
    if (window.p2update) window.p2update();

  window.p2res = () => document.body.dataset.res || keys[0];
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {{
    const s = document.getElementById("p2-res-slider");
    s.addEventListener("input", () => set(+s.value));
    set(0);
  }});
}})();
</script>""")

:::::: {.panel-tabset}

## Overview

**Question.** Which PCA → kNN → Leiden pipeline gives the best stability, accuracy and cost, and
how does that change with the number of cells? Where do differences between implementations
come from, stage by stage? And when is a GPU worth it, measured rather than assumed? Plan and
definitions: `docs/phase2-plan.md`.

**Design.** Each stage tab reads its own slice of the plan: that stage varies, the other two
stay at the exact baselines (covariance-eigh PCA, brute-force kNN, leidenalg run to
convergence) with their seed fixed, so every difference belongs to that stage. The Full
pipeline tab reads five named end-to-end pipelines with matched seeds.

| Pipeline | PCA | kNN | Leiden |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | covariance-eigh (CPU) | brute force (CPU) | leidenalg |
| scanpy-defaults | arpack | pynndescent, 1 thread | igraph, 2 iterations |
| tuned-cpu | randomized (CPU) | pynndescent, 8 threads | leidenalg |
| all-gpu | covariance-eigh (GPU) | brute force (GPU) | cuGraph |
| hybrid | covariance-eigh (GPU) | brute force (GPU) | leidenalg |

```{python}
#| output: asis
folders = runs["run"].fillna("").astype(str).nunique() if len(runs) else 0
print(f"**This report:** {len(runs):,} clusterings, {len(datasets)} dataset(s), {len(bounds)} dataset × "
      f"size combinations, {len(RES_KEYS) - 1} resolutions, {folders} output folder(s)"
      f"{' (same-seed replicates: reproducibility is measured)' if folders > 1 else ' (no replicates: no reproducibility yet)'}.\n")
table(bounds.sort_values(["dataset", "cells"]).rename(columns={
    "subsample": "size", "oracle_logreg": "oracle: logistic regression", "oracle_knn": "oracle: 15-NN",
    "oracle": "oracle (the better)"})[["dataset", "size", "cells", "labels", "chance", "oracle: logistic regression",
                                       "oracle: 15-NN", "oracle (the better)"]])
```

| Subtab | What it shows |
|---|---|
| **Stability** | Agreement between runs that differ only in a seed, in one output folder; **reproducibility**: the same seed run again in another folder. PCA and kNN on their own measure and downstream (final clusters). Modules without a seed have reproducibility only. |
| **Concordance** | Agreement between implementations, against each one's own seed noise (grey). No significance tests: the gap is the result. |
| **Accuracy** | PCA and kNN: **fidelity** to the exact module (variance-weighted share of the exact top-50 variance; recall of the exact neighbours) and downstream accuracy. Leiden: ARI against the reference labels as a share of the range between chance (0) and the oracle bound. |
| **Cost** | Wall time of the stage's own job; per answer in Full pipeline. |

**Resolution slider** (top of the page). Leiden runs at every resolution of the sweep; the
slider shows every resolution-dependent result at one of them. At **each method's best
(oracle)**, the PCA and kNN tabs read downstream results at the baseline pipeline's oracle
resolution, so a worse stage cannot be rescued by another resolution, and the Clustering and
Full pipeline tabs read each implementation or pipeline at its own: a choice a user without
labels cannot make. Results that do not depend on Leiden (PCA and kNN on their own measures,
their cost) do not move.

### Trade-off and thresholds

```{python}
#| output: asis
if len(pipes):
    data = pipes.rename(columns={"subsample": "size"})[
        ["res_key", "dataset", "size", "cells", "pipeline", "accuracy_share", "stability", "cost_s", "log10_cost_vs_fastest"]]
    data = json.loads(data.to_json(orient="records"))
    raw("""
<div class="p2-sliders">
<p><b>Trade-off</b> = w<sub>acc</sub> × accuracy (share of oracle) + w<sub>stab</sub> × stability
− w<sub>cost</sub> × log10(cost / fastest cost at that dataset and size). Absolute scales, so a
pipeline's score does not change when another is added; the weights are a preference. Best per
row highlighted. Follows the resolution slider.</p>
<label>w<sub>acc</sub> <input type="range" id="w-acc" min="0" max="3" step="0.25" value="1"> <span></span></label>
<label>w<sub>stab</sub> <input type="range" id="w-stab" min="0" max="3" step="0.25" value="1"> <span></span></label>
<label>w<sub>cost</sub> <input type="range" id="w-cost" min="0" max="3" step="0.25" value="1"> <span></span></label>
<div id="p2-trade" class="tbl"></div>
<p><b>Fastest pipeline meeting both thresholds</b> (no weights): accuracy within the chosen margin
of the best pipeline at that dataset and size, and stability at least the chosen value.</p>
<label>accuracy within <input type="range" id="t-acc" min="0" max="25" step="1" value="5"> <span></span></label>
<label>stability ≥ <input type="range" id="t-stab" min="0.5" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.9"> <span></span></label>
<div id="p2-thresh" class="tbl"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const rows = """ + json.dumps(data) + """;
  const order = """ + json.dumps(PIPE_ORDER) + """;
  const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const fmt = (v, d) => (v === null || v === undefined || !isFinite(v)) ? "—" : v.toFixed(d);
  function groups(key) {
    const g = new Map();
    rows.filter(r => r.res_key === key).forEach(r => {
      const k = r.dataset + "|" + r.size;
      if (!g.has(k)) g.set(k, []);
      g.get(k).push(r);
    });
    return [...g.values()].sort((a, b) => a[0].dataset.localeCompare(b[0].dataset) || a[0].cells - b[0].cells);
  }
  function update() {
    const key = window.p2res ? window.p2res() : "oracle";
    const w = {acc: +$("w-acc").value, stab: +$("w-stab").value, cost: +$("w-cost").value};
    const t = {acc: +$("t-acc").value, stab: +$("t-stab").value};
    $("w-acc").nextElementSibling.textContent = w.acc;
    $("w-stab").nextElementSibling.textContent = w.stab;
    $("w-cost").nextElementSibling.textContent = w.cost;
    $("t-acc").nextElementSibling.textContent = t.acc + "% of the best";
    $("t-stab").nextElementSibling.textContent = t.stab.toFixed(2);
    const gs = groups(key);
    const names = order.filter(n => rows.some(r => r.pipeline === n));
    let h = "<table><thead><tr><th>dataset</th><th>size</th><th>cells</th>" +
            names.map(n => "<th>" + n + "</th>").join("") + "</tr></thead><tbody>";
    gs.forEach(g => {
      const score = {};
      g.forEach(r => {
        const s = w.acc * r.accuracy_share + w.stab * r.stability - w.cost * r.log10_cost_vs_fastest;
        score[r.pipeline] = isFinite(s) ? s : null;
      });
      const vals = Object.values(score).filter(v => v !== null);
      const best = vals.length ? Math.max(...vals) : null;
      h += "<tr><td>" + g[0].dataset + "</td><td>" + g[0].size + "</td><td>" + g[0].cells + "</td>" +
           names.map(n => "<td" + (score[n] !== null && score[n] === best ? ' class="best"' : "") + ">" +
                     fmt(score[n], 3) + "</td>").join("") + "</tr>";
    });
    $("p2-trade").innerHTML = h + "</tbody></table>";
    let k = "<table><thead><tr><th>dataset</th><th>size</th><th>cells</th><th>fastest pipeline</th>" +
            "<th>wall time (s)</th><th>pipelines meeting both</th></tr></thead><tbody>";
    gs.forEach(g => {
      const bestAcc = Math.max(...g.map(r => r.accuracy_share).filter(isFinite));
      const ok = g.filter(r => r.accuracy_share >= (1 - t.acc / 100) * bestAcc && r.stability >= t.stab)
                  .sort((a, b) => a.cost_s - b.cost_s);
      k += "<tr><td>" + g[0].dataset + "</td><td>" + g[0].size + "</td><td>" + g[0].cells + "</td><td>" +
           (ok.length ? ok[0].pipeline : "none meets both") + "</td><td>" +
           (ok.length ? fmt(ok[0].cost_s, 1) : "—") + "</td><td>" + ok.length + "</td></tr>";
    });
    $("p2-thresh").innerHTML = k + "</tbody></table>";
  }
  const prev = window.p2update;
  window.p2update = () => { if (prev) prev(); update(); };
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    ["w-acc", "w-stab", "w-cost", "t-acc", "t-stab"].forEach(id => $(id).addEventListener("input", update));
    update();
  });
})();
</script>""")
```
